learning_outcomes.text: Students master the classification of manufacturing processes.

They know the application possibilities of the various processes with their technological limits and basic cost structures of manufacturing facilities and tools, and can select suitable manufacturing processes with regard to technological and economic boundary conditions.
Students know possible quality problems of the treated processes and can suggest remedial measures.
Students understand the necessity of design for manufacturing and assembly and master the basic design guidelines.

syllabus_topics: Primary shaping processes: Casting, Plastics technology, Sintering and Rapid Prototyping
Forming processes: Rolling, Drawing, Pressing, Forging
Separating processes: Punching, Shearing, Turning, Milling, Grinding, Honing, Lapping
Joining processes of material, form and force fit
assessment_rules: Credit points are awarded upon successful completion of the module exam.
